summary: 72 cm HS: basal DH 0-9 cm (P then 4F+, 1.5-4 mm) under a 1 cm Oct 20 rain crust (IF, K) at 9-10 cm, then flagged FC(DH) 10-20 cm (F; CT22 SC at 19 cm x3), FC 20-46 cm (4F-/4F), a 0.5 mm FCxr 1F- layer at 46-54 cm under the Dec 7 SH interface at 54 cm (CT12 RP x2), and DF 54-72 cm (4F, 4F-); graupel on the surface; PF 60; temperature -0.5 at ground to -5.0 at 60 cm and -3.5 at the surface
reading_issues: PDF is a single embedded 994x840 SnowPilot raster, extracted at native resolution. Hardness bar edges and layer boundaries measured from pixels against the axis ticks (tall ticks = I/K/P/1F/4F/F; minor ticks = +/- thirds); boundaries are integer cm (the thin crust at 9-10 cm and DH at 7-9 cm measure 9.1/10.07/7.04 cm and agree with the "10-9cm" layer note). Table rows for the three thin basal layers are stretched with connector lines. Temperature dots read against the top axis (43.3 px/degC): ground -0.5, then every 10 cm to 60 cm, plus the surface point at 72 cm (-3.5, equal to the air temperature). The top-row surface-form glyph (asterisk over open triangle) is read as graupel (PPgp); the top-level surface_grain "PP" rests on that reading. Glyph at 46-54 cm (rounded-top square with centre line) read as FCxr. Sizes of the form "a(b)" recorded as the primary form size, secondary in the comment. The Dec 7 SH is named only in the test comment (no SH layer in the table); layer_grain "SH" for that test follows the comment. Elevation printed 2300 m (other visits of this plot print 2280, 2295 and 2400 m). The red line at 20 cm is the problematic-layer flag, not a test.
